label: development
journal_validation: complete positions; balanced entry/exit volume; no inout reversals
extra_cost_model: Native fees retained; commission topped up to at least USD7/lot roundtrip, plus USD20/lot adverse slippage. Stress targets USD14 commission plus USD40 slippage, without double-counting native fees. Assumes USD gold and a 100-unit contract for the fixed slippage allowance.
limitation: Additional costs are journal overlays; native position sizing used broker-reported account equity before these extra overlays. Closed-balance drawdown uses completed positions and excludes open-position excursions. Planned stop risk is matched only to an exact entry timestamp.
